text:
alice: Preflight: Deploybot will run the live tenant_backfill at 03:00 UTC in the quiesce window. Staging run showed transient lock spikes (~10-15s row locks). Opening this thread to confirm rollback criteria, pinning, and throttle settings.

ben: ack — I'm on lockwatch for the run. Can you paste the relevant staging tail (pg_locks / wait events)?

alice: Pasted a small snippet from staging run around 03:12:45 (redacted IDs):
```
2026-03-20 03:12:45 UTC [shard-3] PID 2345 waiting for row exclusive lock on table tenant_data (granted=false)
2026-03-20 03:12:46 UTC [shard-3] PID 2360 holder PID 2311 on xid 56789
2026-03-20 03:12:58 UTC [shard-3] PID 2345 wait 13s, queued
```

deploybot: Automated: Canary job tenant_backfill started (id: dbbf-2026-03-21-03). Progress pings every 5m.

charlie: Proposal: If we detect >3 concurrent lock waits each >30s across >2 shards, auto-pause the backfill, escalate to #eng-oncall, and reduce batch_size. Otherwise let it continue. Agree?

diane: +1. Also propose pinning the migration tool to v2.4.1 for this run — v2.5 introduced a different batching heuristic that caused a different lock pattern last month.

ben: Noted. I'll watch and can trigger manual rollback if deadlocks escalate. Suggested immediate mitigation on pause: switch to batch_size=128 + enable KV cache.

infra-bot: Observability: registered watch rule `backfill_long_waits` -> will open an incident if threshold crossed (3 locks >30s across 2 shards).

alice: Runbook summary for this thread: 1) Preflight check: run `select count(*) from pg_locks where granted = false;` — if >0 delay start by 5m. 2) On threshold breach: deploybot auto-pause + patch to batch_size=128 and KV cache on, retry up to 3x. 3) If still failing after retries -> stop backfill, rollback schema migration (revert migration flag), open incident, and coordinate traffic pin fallback.

charlie: Addendum — make sure deploybot emits the paused job snapshot (`deploybot job snapshot <id>`) so we can reproduce locally.

diane: I'll draft the short release note blurb: "Running live tenant_backfill (v2.4.1) during quiesce window; monitoring locks; auto-pause on long waits." Will post shortly.

erica: oncall here — I'll be standing by for alerts and will coordinate with infra for rollbacks if the incident fires.

alice: Thanks — I'll kick at 03:00 UTC and post updates here. :rocket:
